## Activity

Market Eye Clinic completed 378 photographic captures during July 2025. This provides the activity total for the month and confirms that screening activity continued at the site throughout the reporting period. The recorded volume should be considered alongside the image-quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

A total of 75 captures were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 19.8 of captures. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is reported separately from the overall activity total. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

There were 89 referable results during July 2025. The median grading lag was 1 day. This is the midpoint for the time taken to complete grading and report the outcome. The activity, image-quality and grading measures should be reviewed together when monitoring the operation of Market Eye Clinic.
